correctness.rationale: Triangle inequalities yield adjacent Lipschitz-constrained words. All labels at least ceil(D/2) form a primitive symmetric path walk. Subcritical low symbols force both tails into a strictly smaller alphabet with sub-Perron growth. For odd D the sole critical label occurs in span length at most D and its first-to-last convolution produces a double Perron pole and explicit positive n*lambda^n coefficient; even D has no critical label. Boundary dimensions D=2,3 and constants are checked. Independent brute force and exact DP match for stated finite ranges; infinite assertions derive from proof.

value.rationale: Type growth over a finite named base is a natural orbit-theoretic invariant of the universal finite-distance metric structure. The result determines for every fixed diameter the exact exponential rate and leading prefactor, exposing a genuine odd/even polynomial-degree transition despite equal exponential entropy for adjacent bounds; the finite critical-defect span gives the mechanism and useful comparison benchmark.
